lines.sk: Mám sa dobre, ďakujem. A vy?
lines.en: I'm well, thank you. And you?

questions.q: Do they speak formally or informally?

lines.sk: Ahoj, ja som Marek. Ako sa voláš?
lines.en: Hi, I'm Marek. What's your name?

lines.sk: Ahoj, volám sa Anna. Teší ma.
lines.en: Hi, my name is Anna. Nice to meet you.

lines.sk: Som z Ameriky, ale bývam v Bratislave.
lines.en: I'm from America, but I live in Bratislava.
A coffee and a water, please.
Excuse me, where is the station?

lines.sk: Stanica? Choďte rovno a potom vľavo.
lines.en: The station? Go straight and then left.

lines.sk: Nie, je to blízko. Päť minút.

lines.en: Do you know where the key is?
No. Not in the kitchen either.
Yes, it's in the car! Thanks.

questions.q: Where was the key in the end?

lines.en: Hi! Are you free tomorrow evening?
I can't tomorrow, I have to work.

lines.sk: V piatok áno. Čo chceš robiť?
lines.en: Friday, yes. What do you want to do?
We could go to the cinema.
Great, I'm looking forward to it.

lines.sk: Bolí ma hlava a mám horúčku.
lines.en: I have a headache and a fever.

lines.sk: Je to chrípka. Musíte ležať doma.
lines.en: It's the flu. You need to stay in bed at home.

lines.sk: Máte tento kabát v inej veľkosti?
lines.en: Do you have this coat in another size?

lines.sk: Menšiu, prosím. Je to v zľave?
lines.en: A smaller one, please. Is it on sale?

lines.sk: Áno, dnes je o dvadsať percent lacnejší.
lines.en: Yes, today it's twenty percent cheaper.
Return. When does the train leave?

lines.sk: O pol desiatej z tretieho nástupišťa.
lines.en: At half past nine, from platform three.
lines.note: o pol desiatej = "at half of ten", i.e. 9:30

lines.en: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

lines.sk: Škoda. Chcel som ísť do Tatier.
lines.en: Pity. I wanted to go to the Tatras.

lines.sk: Pôjdeme v sobotu. V sobotu bude svietiť slnko.
lines.en: We'll go on Saturday. On Saturday the sun will shine.

questions.q: When will they go to the mountains?

lines.sk: Počul si? Peter a Zuzana sa rozišli!
lines.en: Did you hear? Peter and Zuzana broke up!

lines.sk: Jej mama. Ale nikomu to nehovor!
lines.en: Her mom. But don't tell anyone!

lines.sk: Čo by si chcela robiť dnes večer?
lines.en: What would you like to do tonight?

lines.sk: Rada by som zostala doma a pozerala film.
lines.en: I'd like to stay home and watch a movie.

lines.sk: To by bolo super. Uvarím večeru.
lines.en: That would be great. I'll cook dinner.

questions.q: What would she like to do?
options: Stay home and watch a movie

prompts.q: Ako sa voláš a odkiaľ si?
prompts.en: What's your name and where are you from?
prompts.sample: Volám sa {name} a som z Ameriky.
prompts.sampleEn: My name is {name} and I'm from America.

prompts.sample: Moja rodina žije v štáte Maine. Mám ich veľmi rada.
prompts.sampleEn: My family lives in Maine. I love them very much.

prompts.en: What do you like to eat and drink?
prompts.sample: Rada jem polievku a pijem kávu.
prompts.sampleEn: I like eating soup and drinking coffee.

prompts.sample: Dnes som trochu unavená, ale šťastná.
prompts.sampleEn: Today I'm a bit tired, but happy.

prompts.en: What did you do at the weekend?
prompts.sample: Cez víkend som bola doma a varila som.
prompts.sampleEn: At the weekend I was at home and cooked.

prompts.sample: Vstávam o siedmej, idem do práce a večer varím večeru.
prompts.sampleEn: I get up at seven, go to work and cook dinner in the evening.

prompts.sample: Zajtra budem pracovať a večer zavolám mame.
prompts.sampleEn: Tomorrow I'll work and in the evening I'll call my mom.

prompts.q: Čo by si chcela robiť na Slovensku?
prompts.en: What would you like to do in Slovakia?
prompts.sample: Rada by som išla do Tatier a ochutnala bryndzové halušky.
prompts.sampleEn: I'd like to go to the Tatras and taste bryndzové halušky.

prompts.sample: Učím sa po slovensky, aby som rozumela tvojej rodine.
prompts.sampleEn: I'm learning Slovak so I can understand your family.

prompts.en: What brings you in? (Play the patient: describe a problem.)
prompts.sample: Už týždeň nemôžem spať a stále som unavená.
prompts.sampleEn: I haven't been able to sleep for a week and I'm always tired.

prompts.sample: Oblečiem si modré nohavice a biely kabát.
prompts.sampleEn: I'll wear blue trousers and a white coat.

prompts.sample: Môj byt je malý, ale útulný. Má kuchyňu, spálňu a balkón.
prompts.sampleEn: My apartment is small but cosy. It has a kitchen, a bedroom and a balcony.

prompts.sample: Môj brat je vysoký a veľmi vtipný.
prompts.sampleEn: My brother is tall and very funny.

prompts.en: How do you celebrate your birthday?
prompts.sample: Rada pozývam priateľov na večeru a pečiem tortu.
prompts.sampleEn: I like inviting friends for dinner and baking a cake.

prompts.en: What do you do in your free time?
prompts.sample: Rada skúšam nové reštaurácie a skladám puzzle s priateľmi.
prompts.sampleEn: I like trying new restaurants and doing puzzles with friends.

prompts.en: What's the last thing you bought yourself?

prompts.sample: Viem dobre variť a hovorím po francúzsky.
prompts.sampleEn: I'm good at cooking and I speak French.
